entries.speaker: Rush
entries.en: If you press [clr 2][f 1 10 60][clr 27] during battle, your party will[n]continually perform melee attacks. This is called[n][clr 2]Rush[clr 27] mode.

entries.speaker: Rush
entries.en: Battle proceeds faster during Rush and you will[n]not need to input actions. Rush can be canceled[n]by pressing [clr 2][f 1 10 70][clr 27].
